fact_english: Calamansi is a hybrid fruit, generally thought to be a cross between a kumquat and a mandarin.
source_onscreen: Pinagmulan: Wikipedia; UC Riverside Citrus Variety Collection

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang kalamansi, par, hybrid pala, karaniwang itinuturing na krus ng kumquat at mandarin.

after_text: Sumindi ito, at sa pader, nakita ko ang tunay na anino ng reyna, may pakpak na nasunog.
why_here: After the queen's true shadow is shown on the wall: Usman names it right after.
